title: The Great Conspiracy, Complete

authorInfo.bio: John Alexander Logan (1826–1886) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Great Conspiracy, Complete" by John Alexander Logan is a historical account written during the late 19th century that delves into the origins and development of what the author refers to as the Great Conspiracy surrounding the American Civil War and its contributing factors. The book examines the historical context of slavery, sectional tensions, and the political maneuverings that fueled the conflict, aiming for historical accuracy and objectivity in presenting the facts.
